snippet.title: GTA Backstabber’s Blues - Full Chapter 1 Walkthrough In 4K
snippet.description:
Grand Theft Auto Backstabber’s Blues - Full Chapter 1 Walkthrough In 4K played at 60fps and on PC.

GTA Backstabber’s Blues is a mod for GTA Vice City and can be played on PC. 

This mod is the first part of Lance's revenge story which is still in development and looks really promising.

All credit goes to the Developers of this mod and conversions.

Follow me on Tiktok.

TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@rockstarhillson?lang=en

1:11:14 Mission 5 - Daddy’s Little Angel

2:32:11 Stranger Mission 3 - Clean Slate
2:36:23 Mission 10 - Pursuit Of The Pimpmobile
2:42:17 Mission 11 - The Trade Of The Tricks
3:02:37 Mission 12 - Wrong Number
